overview.headline: Population genetics links allele patterns to evolution and identity

keyPoints.point: Population genetics tracks distribution and change in allele frequencies across groups
keyPoints.quote: Population genetics is the study of the distribution of and change in allele frequencies

keyPoints.point: Descriptive statistics summarize large collections of population data clearly and concisely
keyPoints.quote: Descriptive statistics are used to summarize a collection of population data in a clear and concise manner.

keyPoints.point: Biology defines population as a group whose members breed mainly among themselves
keyPoints.quote: In biology, a population generally denotes a group whose members breed primarily or solely among themselves.

keyPoints.point: Research shows racial classifications poorly describe distribution of human genetic variation
keyPoints.quote: Research has demonstrated that racial classifications are inadequate descriptors of the distribution of genetic variation in the human species.
